title: Shrink
prompt: Return the rectangle made smaller by margin on every side.
signature: func solve(r: Rect2, margin: float) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(r: Rect2, margin: float) -> Rect2:
	return r
hint: Growing by a negative amount shrinks.
solution:
func solve(r: Rect2, margin: float) -> Rect2:
	return r.grow(-margin)
